选择一个类别，专注调整当前设置。: Choose a category to focus on the settings you need.
加密文件交换与本地恢复: Encrypted file exchange and local recovery
备份包含哪些内容: What is included in a backup
导出可迁移的配置文件，API Key 单独保存在本机凭据管理器。: Export a portable configuration file. API keys remain in the local credential store.
选择备份后查看确认说明，再决定是否导入。: Choose a backup, review the confirmation details, then decide whether to import it.
批量选择只更新处理方式，确认后才会应用。: Bulk choices only update how changes are handled. Changes are applied after confirmation.
先检查将导出的配置，再设置加密口令。: Review the configuration to export, then set an encryption passphrase.
输入文件口令后选择文件；预览不会自动导入。: Enter the file passphrase, then choose a file. Previewing does not import it.
仅分析已保存的请求记录，不会自动发送探针。: Only analyzes saved request records. No probes are sent automatically.
将合并 {incoming} 项；{local} 项保留本地 / 跳过。: {incoming} items will be merged; {local} items will stay local or be skipped.
还有 {count} 项未选择处理方式。: Choose how to handle the remaining {count} items.
全部保留本地，无需导入；可取消并清除预览。: All items will stay local. Nothing needs to be imported; you can cancel and clear the preview.
将回滚同步变更；新增供应商保留为禁用。: Sync changes will be rolled back; newly added providers will be kept disabled.
选择后立即生效并保存。: Selections take effect and are saved immediately.
本机偏好、运行连接与数据交换。: Local preferences, active connections and data exchange.
此对象与本地一致，不会写入。: This item matches the local state. Nothing will be written.
已选择保留本地 / 跳过，此对象不会写入。: Keep local / skip selected. This item will not be written.
已选择接受传入项，最终确认后才会合并。: Accept incoming selected. This item will be merged only after final confirmation.
请先选择此对象的处理方式。: Choose how to handle this item first.
用量与预留以已保存策略为准。: Usage and reservations reflect the saved policy.
+ 新增，− 移除，CR 回车符；双侧行号分别对应两侧内容，折叠行可在下方完整内: + added, − removed, CR carriage return. Line numbers refer to each side; expand the full content below to read folded lines.
此任务已不可用，请刷新任务列表。: This task is no longer available. Refresh the task list.
回滚会在同一事务中自动备份当前配置。: Rollback automatically backs up the current configuration in the same transaction.
